backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor defining order, user, security, and admin types with access control, storage mixins, and rate‑limiting logic, initializing maps and state for orders, profiles, and security events.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping UI disclaimer‑removal features to affected files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and recent changes of each frontend component, page, and hook.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment variable file showing required backend canister ID, II URL, and optional asset/CDN settings for local development.
frontend/.env.production: Production environment variable template requiring injected backend canister ID and defining II and optional CDN configuration.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide detailing prerequisites, admin bootstrap steps, security notes, and instructions for deploying the app to the IC mainnet.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining color variables, theme tokens, and dark‑mode overrides for global styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry loading fonts and mounting React app via main.tsx.
frontend/PERF.md: Performance audit documenting identified bottlenecks and implemented optimizations such as code‑splitting, image compression, query tuning, and memoization.
frontend/public/.ic-assets.json5: Defines caching and security headers for assets deployed on the Internet Computer.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Specifies allowed and disallowed crawler paths and links to the sitemap.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing main public routes with frequency and priority metadata.
frontend/scripts/deploy-mainnet.sh: Automates mainnet deployment, validating env vars, building the frontend, and deploying via dfx.
frontend/scripts/validate-production-env: Checks production environment settings, ensuring backend canister ID and dfx availability.
frontend/src/@types/html2canvas.d.ts: Empty type declaration stub for html2canvas.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing, authentication redirects, and lazy-loaded dashboard/admin pages.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAcces: UI for owner-only admin access management, including granting and revoking admin email permissions with validation and loading states.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminTheme: Dropdown component allowing admins to select and apply a UI theme from available options.
frontend/src/components/admin/AuditLogSe: Displays searchable, filterable admin audit logs with loading, error handling, and retry support.
frontend/src/components/admin/BulkOrderA: Action bar for bulk approving, shipping, or deleting selected orders with confirmation dialogs and status indicators.
frontend/src/components/admin/TreyCSecur: Full security admin panel for managing security config, rate limits, block/allow lists, and viewing stats and events.

frontend/src/components/AdminThemeLayout: Applies admin-specific theme and background wrappers around children components.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Global layout with header, footer, SEO component, and accessibility anchor.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Requires user authentication and shows a loading or login-required screen if not authenticated.
frontend/src/components/AuthRequiredScre: Displays a card prompting the user to authenticate via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AuthStatusButton: Provides a sign‑in/out button using Internet Identity, handling login state and redirects.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Top navigation header with logo, responsive menus, auth/admin-aware nav items, and mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/PageHe: Simple page header component rendering a title, optional description, and optional action element.
frontend/src/components/forms/InlineFiel: Inline form message component showing error, success, or info states with icons.

frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.ts: Renders a styled ID card preview with photo, personal details, and state seal.
frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx: Deprecated no-op watermark component kept for compatibility.
frontend/src/components/NoveltyDisclaime: Displays a simple banner with an 'Order Now' message.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCropModal.t: Modal for cropping an uploaded photo using drag positioning and zoom before saving.
frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Image uploader with drag‑and‑drop, validation, preview, and optional clear button.
frontend/src/components/RoleplayDisclaim: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/SeoHead.tsx: Updates document title, meta tags, canonical link, and structured data based on route.
frontend/src/components/StateSeal.tsx: Displays a state seal image or a fallback icon if the seal cannot be loaded.
frontend/src/components/TreyCSecurityPro: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/constants/usStates.ts: Exports a static list of U.S. states with two-letter codes and names.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Centralized text constants for landing page, order form, and disclaimers.
frontend/src/hooks/admin/AdminThemeProvi: Context provider managing admin theme state per-identity with localStorage persistence and a hook to access it.
Provides hooks to list, grant, and revoke admin emails using React Query and invalidates related caches.

frontend/src/hooks/admin/useAdminTheme.t: Exposes the admin theme context and defines available admin theme types.
frontend/src/hooks/admin/useAuditLog.ts: Fetches audit log entries with polling and visibility‑aware refetching using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/admin/useBulkOrderAct: Provides bulk approve, ship, and delete order mutations and invalidates the all‑orders query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useCallerUserPro: Fetches the current caller's user profile and returns deterministic loading and fetched states.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useIsAdmin.ts: Checks if the authenticated caller is an admin and manages loading state across identity and actor readiness.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/queryKeys.ts: Defines React Query key generators for orders, auth, security, and audit log data.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useAllOrders.t: Fetches all orders for admins and handles unauthorized errors explicitly.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useCreateOrder: Creates a new order with extensive field validation and normalization before calling the backend.

frontend/src/hooks/orders/useGetOrder.ts: Fetches a single order by ID when the actor is ready and an ID is provided.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useSetTracking: Sets an order's tracking number with validation and invalidates order queries on success.

frontend/src/hooks/security/useCsrfToken: Prepares a CSRF token mechanism, currently returning null until backend support exists.
frontend/src/hooks/security/useSecurityC: Fetches the system's security configuration from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/security/useSecurityE: Fetches security events with periodic polling that stops when the tab is hidden.
frontend/src/hooks/security/useSecurityM: Defines React Query mutations for toggling security, updating rate limits, clearing counters, and managing blocklists using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/security/useSecurityS: Provides a query hook that fetches security stats from the backend with periodic refetching.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context and provider for authentication, identity persistence, and login/logout handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and custom theme variables for light/dark modes, plus utility classes for accessibility and layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin interface for managing orders, bulk actions, filtering, and accessing security, audit, and access-control sections.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard showing order list, creation banner, and navigation to create new orders.
frontend/src/pages/ErrorPage.tsx: Displays a generic error screen with optional debug info and provides retry and home-navigation actions.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page introducing the service with a hero section and steps explaining how the system works.
frontend/src/pages/NewOrderPage.tsx: Form-driven page for creating a new ID order with photo upload, validation, live preview, and submission handling.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Renders a 404 page with a message and a button to return the user to the home or dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific order including status, ID preview, and navigation back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Provides Internet Identity login flow with status handling and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: Intro page guiding users toward creating or using an Internet Identity, linking directly to the sign-in page.

frontend/src/utils/exportOrdersCsv.ts: Generates and downloads a CSV export of order data with proper escaping.

frontend/src/utils/generateIdNumber.ts: Creates an 8-digit random numeric ID string.
frontend/src/utils/stateFormat.ts: Normalizes US state codes and names and retrieves state codes from names.
frontend/src/utils/stateSeals.ts: Returns the asset path for a state seal image based on the state's name.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Manages URL parameters and session-backed persistence for routing and tokens.
frontend/src/utils/validation.ts: Validates and normalizes user input fields such as names, addresses, ZIP codes, and height.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining themes, colors, plugins, and responsive settings.
